data.name: CO2Re
data.description: CO₂RE is the UK's national research hub on Greenhouse Gas Removal, led by the Smith School, University of Oxford. It conducts research, co-ordinates demonstration projects around the UK, connects to other relevant national and international programmes, and commissions grants through a flexible fund. It also develops the CO2RE GGR Evaluation Framework and policy guidance rather than physically removing CO2 itself.
